title: Case: Signature requirement lost in multi-shipment thread
context: A high-value camera shipment requires signature on delivery but the requirement has been buried in a long thread about multiple unrelated parcels, auto-replies, and system messages. The desk must identify the relevant fact and contact the correct party to ensure the signature protocol is enforced.
initial_request: Coordinate delivery of DL-9847, a high-value camera, ensuring signature is collected.

events.body: Batch shipment notification: DL-9844 (frozen vegetables, cold chain), DL-9845 (tinned goods, standard), DL-9846 (herb oils, standard), DL-9847 (Canon EOS R6 camera, high-value, signature required on delivery), DL-9848 (kitchen utensils, standard). All five parcels dispatched 2026-04-10 06:30 UTC to postcodes in the Manchester area. See attached manifest.
Auto-reply: Your email has been received. Standard processing time for dispatch coordination is 2-4 hours. If urgent, contact Dispatch chat. Thank you for using Plover Arc Logistics.
When will my frozen order arrive? I need it before 14:00 today for catering prep. It's marked cold chain. Please confirm ETA.
DL-9844 is on vehicle 7, ETA 13:15-13:45 Manchester zone. Driver will ring doorbell. Have freezer space ready.
Unrelated: authorisation granted for return of damaged desk lamp from order TG-567. Not your shipment.
DL-9845 and DL-9846 delivered to Spindle Trading Ltd, signatures obtained. DL-9844 in progress, on time. DL-9848 has postcode ambiguity, hold on that one.
Generic footer message: We value your partnership. For urgent warehouse issues contact warehouse.dispatch@brineleaf.co.uk. For customer complaints escalate to safety-lead@brineleaf.co.uk.
DL-9844 delivered 14:08. Customer happy. Cold chain maintained. Now prepping vehicle 12 for Manchester zone round 2. Will include DL-9847 and DL-9848 once ambiguity resolved.
Invoice query: DL-9844, DL-9845, DL-9846 on manifest batch show cold-chain and standard rates. Are all three billed correctly? Please confirm.
DL-9848 postcode now resolved. Vehicle 12 departing 15:35 with DL-9847 and DL-9848, ETA recipient zone 16:30-17:15.
Delivery arrived on time and perfect condition. Thank you for coordinating. I will use Brineleaf again.
Vehicle 12 on route. Driver Kenan is assigned. Standard process for both parcels.
Hold: DL-9847 recipient address has no safe place note and no signature instruction in current job. Vehicle is 8 mins away. Do we proceed standard or abort and re-route? Need instruction now.

acceptable_actions.summary: Confirm that DL-9847 requires signature collection and proceed with delivery instruction to driver Kenan.

must: Identify that event 1 states DL-9847 requires signature on delivery
Confirm signature requirement to Dispatch immediately to prevent re-route or failed delivery
Reference the correct shipment DL-9847 (not the others in the batch)
must_not: Ask Dispatch to confirm the requirement instead of stating it clearly
Contact Warehouse dispatch or Brineleaf to re-verify signature requirement (already in event 1)
Suggest re-routing or aborting without first confirming the signature protocol
Treat DL-9844 delivery or DL-9848 ambiguity as relevant to this decision
expected.reference_message: DL-9847 requires signature on delivery per warehouse dispatch manifest. Please instruct driver Kenan to obtain recipient signature and confirm once complete.

rationale: Event 1 clearly states DL-9847 is high-value and requires signature on delivery. The long thread of other shipments, auto-replies, and unrelated messages obscures this fact, but it is definitive. Dispatch has now asked for instruction with 8 minutes to go. The desk must contact Dispatch immediately to confirm the signature requirement so the driver proceeds correctly. No escalation or re-verification is needed; the original instruction is in writing.
